alt: Manmyung alone in the locked raised house, chima hiked, thinking of him
One lamp. Her hand under the silk. His name bitten into the floor.
Lightning splits the iron-barred door of the raised house-apart
Suulbu standing in his hall over the burned pieces of the door
Two riders in silhouette on a wet ridge, kissing in the storm break
Charcoal hut: wet silk off, one hearth, they are finally free
Manmyung pulls Seohyun to the barred side gate by the collar
